violated_contract: A cache-staleness reason must distinguish a reused decision from independent fresh authority observations that changed between a live check and its later shadow check. Labelling an external fresh ALLOW after a live BLOCK as stale_allow can trip a cache kill guard even when no cached ALLOW was served.
canonical_prevention: Classify only an external live BLOCK followed by an explicitly recorded fresh candidate ALLOW as fresh_authority_change, retaining every mismatch counter and the original live decision. Record fresh provenance only at actual authority reads; default, synthesized, unknown and reused candidates retain conservative stale reasons. Preserve stale_block for the reverse direction. Cover time-based gate expiry without marker changes, legacy evidence and writes before or after the candidate token read.
